find . -name '*.html' -not -path './node_modules/*'
rg -c 'class=.(header|nav|main|sidebar|footer)' src
rg -c '<(header|nav|main|aside|footer)' src
rg -c '<main' src
npx axe http://localhost:8080/index.html --exit

cards.title: Plan a skip link to main content
cards.when: Use when a page has a repeated header or nav block that keyboard users must pass before reaching main content.
cards.cmds:
rg -n '<body' src
rg -n 'tabindex=.[1-9]' src
rg -c 'id=.main-content' src
npx axe http://localhost:8080/index.html --exit

cards.title: Plan DOM order to match visual reading order
cards.when: Use when a CSS grid or flexbox layout reorders columns visually, which can break keyboard and screen reader order.

npx playwright test --grep tab-order

cards.title: Plan reduced-motion fallback for layout transitions
cards.when: Use when a layout uses slide-in drawers, animated columns, or smooth scrolling that can cause vestibular discomfort.
cards.cmds:
rg -n 'transition|animation|scroll-behavior' src
rg -c 'prefers-reduced-motion' src
npx playwright test --grep reduced-motion

cards.title: Decide nav token names and file location
cards.when: Use this before writing code to pick CSS custom property names and where they live in a SvelteKit project.
cards.cmds:
find src -name 'tokens*.css'
cat src/app.css
ls src/routes
cat svelte.config.js
grep -c -- '--nav-' plan.md
grep -n '44px' plan.md

cards.title: Set contrast targets for input text and borders
cards.when: When writing the acceptance numbers for input colors in both light and dark themes.

npx playwright --version
grep -n 'axe' package.json

cards.title: Plan the BaseInput.vue component API before building

ls src/components
rg -c 'v-model' src

xcodebuild test -scheme App -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 16' -only-testing:AppTests/PickerLocalizationTests

grep -n 'tokens.css' src/main.tsx

node scripts/contrast.mjs '#767676' '#ffffff'

cards.cmds:
touch src/routes/onboarding/+layout.ts
npm run build
find .svelte-kit/output/prerendered -name '*.html' -path '*onboarding*'
npm run build

cards.title: Derive onboarding progress with $derived, not $effect
cards.when: Use when progress percent or completion state is computed from answer state in an onboarding flow.
cards.cmds:
npx vitest run src/lib/onboarding/progress.test.ts
grep -rn '$effect' src/lib/onboarding

cards.title: Verify chart shows empty message for zero rows
cards.when: Use after adding an empty-data branch to a React chart component and before merging it.
cards.cmds:
npx vitest --version
npx vitest run src/components/LineChart.test.tsx -t empty
grep -n 'No data to display' src/components/LineChart.tsx
npx tsc --noEmit

cards.title: Verify chart error boundary shows fallback alert
cards.when: Use when a chart is wrapped in a React error boundary and you need proof that a thrown render error shows fallback UI.
cards.cmds:
grep -rn 'getDerivedStateFromError' src
npx vitest run src/components/ChartErrorBoundary.test.tsx
grep -c 'role="alert"' src/components/ChartErrorBoundary.tsx
npx eslint src/components/ChartErrorBoundary.tsx

cards.title: Prove empty and error chart states in browser
cards.when: Use when a chart page must show the correct state for an empty API response and a 500 error, verified in a real browser.
cards.cmds:
npx playwright --version
npx playwright test tests/chart-empty.spec.ts
npx playwright test tests/chart-error.spec.ts
npx playwright test tests/chart-empty.spec.ts tests/chart-error.spec.ts --reporter=list

cards.title: Check empty chart state passes axe contrast
cards.when: Use when the empty or error message on a chart must meet WCAG contrast before release.
cards.cmds:
npm run dev
npx axe http://localhost:5173/charts/empty --exit
grep -rn 'empty-state' src/styles
npx eslint src/components/ChartEmptyState.tsx

cards.title: Verify chart props reject invalid state combinations
cards.when: Use when a chart takes a status and a data prop that must agree, so the type checker rejects data present in the empty state.
cards.cmds:
grep -rn 'ChartState' src/types
npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json
grep -c 'ts-expect-error' src/components/chartState.typetest.ts

cards.title: Test all-null series triggers empty state
cards.when: Use when an API returns rows where every value is null, which must show the empty message instead of a blank chart.
cards.cmds:
grep -n 'filter' src/hooks/useChartData.ts
npx vitest run src/hooks/useChartData.test.ts
npx vitest run src/components/LineChart.test.tsx -t all-null
grep -c '^ *it(' src/hooks/useChartData.test.ts

cards.title: Plan enter and exit animations for a React list
cards.when: Use this when items are added or removed from a React list and each item must animate in and out.
cards.cmds:
npm ls motion
rg -n key= src
npm view motion version

cards.title: Plan a staggered list entrance with reduced motion fallback
cards.when: Use this when a React list appears on page load and its items should fade in one after another.
cards.cmds:
rg -n prefers-reduced-motion src
rg -c ListItem src

cards.title: Plan drag reorder animation with Reorder.Group
cards.when: Use this when a React list must be reordered by dragging and the items should slide into their new positions.
cards.cmds:
rg -n Reorder src
npm ls motion
npx tsc --noEmit

cards.title: Plan list reflow with the View Transitions API
cards.when: Use this when a React list changes order or content and the browser should animate the change using document.startViewTransition.
cards.cmds:
rg -n startViewTransition src
npm ls react react-dom

cards.title: Plan transform-only list animations within frame budget
cards.when: Use this when list item animations feel janky or cause layout shifts and the plan must limit them to cheap CSS properties.
cards.cmds:
rg -n transition src
rg -n transition-property src
npx lighthouse http://localhost:3000 --only-categories=performance

cards.title: Plan Playwright timing tests for list animations
cards.when: Use this when a React list animates on add and remove and the plan needs browser tests that check animation timing.
cards.cmds:
test -f playwright.config.ts
find tests -name "*list*"
npx playwright test --list

cards.title: Assert empty list shows status message and zero items
cards.when: After adding an empty state to a React list component and before merging the change.

test -f src/components/UserList.test.jsx
npx vitest run src/components/UserList.test.jsx -t empty
npx vitest run src/components/UserList.test.jsx --reporter=verbose

cards.title: Assert failed fetch shows alert and working retry
cards.when: After wiring a loading and error state into a React list that fetches data inside useEffect.
cards.cmds:
test -f src/components/UserList.error.test.jsx
grep -c alert src/components/UserList.jsx
npx vitest run src/components/UserList.error.test.jsx

cards.title: Verify empty and error states in a real browser
cards.when: When unit tests pass but you need proof that the empty and error UI works in Chromium with real network responses.
cards.cmds:
npx playwright install chromium
npx playwright test tests/e2e/userlist-states.spec.ts --list
npx playwright test tests/e2e/userlist-states.spec.ts --reporter=line
npx playwright show-report

cards.title: Scan empty and error views for accessibility violations
cards.when: Before merging an empty or error state that adds new colors, icons, or text.

npm run dev
npx axe http://localhost:5173/users-empty --exit
npx axe http://localhost:5173/users-error --exit

cards.title: Check error boundary catches a crashing row render
cards.when: After adding a class-based ListErrorBoundary around a React list whose row rendering can throw.

npx vitest run src/components/ListErrorBoundary.test.jsx
npx eslint src/components/ListErrorBoundary.jsx src/components/UserList.jsx

cards.title: Confirm empty message appears within 200 milliseconds

cards.cmds:
grep -n timeout src/components/UserList.timing.test.jsx
npx vitest run src/components/UserList.timing.test.jsx
npx eslint src/components/UserList.jsx

cards.title: Add a manual theme toggle that persists across reloads
cards.when: Use this when visitors must override the OS theme and keep their choice after a page reload.
cards.cmds:
grep -n -e script -e stylesheet index.html
npx playwright test theme-persist.spec.js

cards.title: Verify text contrast in both themes at 4.5:1
cards.when: Use this after building a themed card to confirm that normal text meets the WCAG AA ratio in light and dark modes.
cards.cmds:
npx playwright test contrast-both-themes.spec.js
npx @axe-core/cli http://localhost:8080/index.html --exit
node contrast.js

cards.title: Theme card surface, border, and shadow with reduced motion
cards.when: Use this when a card needs per-theme surface, border, and shadow tokens and a color transition that respects reduced-motion settings.
cards.cmds:
rg -n prefers-reduced-motion styles.css
npx lighthouse http://localhost:8080/index.html --only-categories=accessibility --quiet

cards.title: Detect dark mode from COLORFGBG with a dark fallback
cards.when: Use this when the app must pick a palette at startup and the terminal may or may not report its background.
cards.cmds:
env
cargo test detect_dark

cards.title: Enforce 4.5:1 list contrast with a unit test
cards.when: Use this when every list palette pair must meet WCAG AA text contrast before the theme ships.
cards.cmds:
cargo test contrast
cargo test contrast -- --nocapture

cards.title: Follow the OS dark setting with prefers-color-scheme
cards.when: Use this when the page should match the visitor's operating system theme without a manual toggle.

rg -n prefers-color-scheme styles.css
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://localhost:8080/index.html
npx @axe-core/cli http://localhost:8080/index.html --exit

cards.title: Use light-dark with a fallback for older browsers
cards.when: Use this when a single property needs light and dark values side by side and the browser supports the light-dark function.
cards.cmds:
rg -n light-dark styles.css
grep -c light-dark styles.css
npx @axe-core/cli http://localhost:8080/index.html --exit

cards.title: Use ContentUnavailableView for a field with no results

xcodebuild test -scheme SignupForm -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 16' -only-testing:SignupFormUITests/EmptyResultsTests

cards.title: Disable submit and show ProgressView while saving
cards.when: Use when a form submit call is async and the submit button must block repeat taps while the request runs.
cards.cmds:
grep -rn disabled Sources/SignupForm/
swift test --filter SignupFormStateTests

cards.title: Show error alert with Retry and Cancel actions
cards.when: Use when a failed submit should offer a retry and the error applies to the whole form rather than one field.
cards.cmds:
grep -n func submit Sources/SignupForm/SignupFormModel.swift
xcodebuild test -scheme SignupForm -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 16' -only-testing:SignupFormUITests/ErrorAlertTests

cards.title: Snapshot every form state and check tap target size
cards.when: Use when all five form states are built and need a regression check before merging.

grep -rn func test Tests/SignupFormSnapshotTests.swift
xcrun simctl list devices available
xcodebuild test -scheme SignupForm -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 16' -only-testing:SignupFormSnapshotTests
grep -rn minHeight Sources/SignupForm/

cards.title: Plan the ARIA roles and wiring for tabs

find src -name "Tab*.svelte"
grep -rn 'role="tab"' src

cards.title: Plan roving tabindex and arrow-key tab navigation
cards.when: Use this when deciding how focus moves between tabs, before writing the keydown handler.
cards.cmds:
grep -rln keydown src
node --version

cards.title: Plan bindable selected state with $bindable
cards.when: Use this to decide who owns the active tab index and how the parent shares it, using Svelte 5 runes.
cards.cmds:
npm ls svelte
grep -rn bind: src

cards.title: Plan contrast and touch target thresholds for tabs
cards.when: Use this before styling tabs, to fix the numeric limits the build must meet.
cards.cmds:
grep -rn color src
npx axe --version

cards.title: Plan keyboard and axe tests for the tab group
cards.when: Use this before writing tests, to decide which measurable checks prove the tabs work.
cards.cmds:
npx playwright --version
find tests -name "*.spec.ts"
npx playwright test --list

cards.title: Plan hidden inactive panels and reduced motion

grep -rn prefers-reduced-motion src
ls src/lib

jq '.scripts' package.json

cards.when: Use when a SwiftUI form must show idle, loading, empty, or error states and those states are not yet defined in code.
cards.cmds:
touch Sources/SignupForm/SignupFormState.swift
swiftc -parse Sources/SignupForm/SignupFormState.swift
grep -c case Sources/SignupForm/SignupFormState.swift

cards.title: Show field error text inside the Form section
cards.when: Use when a single TextField fails validation and the error must appear directly under that field.
cards.cmds:
grep -n TextField Sources/SignupForm/SignupForm.swift
touch Tests/SignupFormUITests/ErrorContrastTests.swift
xcodebuild build -scheme SignupForm -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 16'
xcodebuild test -scheme SignupForm -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 16' -only-testing:SignupFormUITests/ErrorContrastTests
grep -c emailError Sources/SignupForm/SignupForm.swift

cards.title: Set text-expansion width budget for layout containers
cards.when: Use this when planning a fixed-width nav or header that must hold translated labels.
cards.cmds:
rg -n 'width: [0-9]+px' src/styles src/components/layout
awk 'BEGIN { print 16 * 1.3 }'
jq 'keys' src/i18n/locales/en.json

cards.title: Detect existing i18n library before choosing one
cards.when: Use this when a React project may already include an i18n package, so the plan does not add a second one.
cards.cmds:
grep -n -e 'i18n' -e 'react-intl' -e 'lingui' -e 'next-intl' package.json
node -p "require('./node_modules/react-i18next/package.json').version"
find src/i18n -name '*.json'

cards.title: Plan where lang and dir are set on the document
cards.when: Use this when planning how the layout learns the active locale and text direction at the root.
cards.cmds:
rg -n -e '<html' -e '<body' index.html src
grep -n 'lang=' index.html
rg -c 'documentElement.dir' src/App.tsx
test -f index.html

cards.title: Set a text length budget for empty-state copy per locale
cards.when: Use before the layout is final, so empty-state boxes fit longer translations such as German or Finnish.

cards.title: Measure menu CSS bytes before choosing a plan

cards.cmds:
grep -n 'tailwindcss' package.json
npx tailwindcss -i ./src/input.css -o ./dist/output.css --minify
wc -c dist/output.css
rg -c 'className' src/components/Menu.tsx

cards.title: Limit menu transitions to transform and opacity
cards.when: Use this when planning how the menu opens and closes so the browser avoids layout work.
cards.cmds:
rg -n 'transition-all' src
rg -F -n 'transition-[opacity,transform]' src

cards.title: Choose CSS-only hover menus before adding JavaScript
cards.when: Use this when deciding whether the menu needs client-side state or can open with Tailwind group and peer variants alone.
cards.cmds:
rg -n 'useState' src/components/Menu.tsx
rg -c 'group-hover:' src/components
npx lighthouse http://localhost:3000 --only-categories=performance --output=json --output-path=./lighthouse-menu.json
jq .categories.performance.score lighthouse-menu.json

cards.title: Scope Tailwind content scanning to menu source only
cards.when: Use this when planning the Tailwind build so it scans only the files that can contain menu classes.

grep -n 'content' tailwind.config.js
rg -c 'node_modules' tailwind.config.js
rg -n '@source' src/index.css
npx tailwindcss -i ./src/input.css -o ./dist/output.css --minify

cards.title: Write a numeric performance gate for the menu plan
cards.when: Use this at the end of planning to set measurable limits the later build and verify stages must meet.
cards.cmds:
test -f dist/output.css
wc -c dist/output.css
rg -c 'className=' src/components/Menu.tsx
npx lighthouse http://localhost:3000 --only-categories=performance --output=json --output-path=./lighthouse-plan.json

cards.title: Confirm chart font tokens exist and no hardcoded sizes remain

grep -nE "font-size: *[0-9]+px" src/components/LineChart.vue
grep -n "\-\-chart-label-size" src/styles/tokens.css
npx vue-tsc --noEmit
npx eslint src/components/LineChart.vue

npx playwright test --grep empty-state

cards.title: Decide which locales need RTL empty-state layout

cards.when: Use this before building a modal whose open and close animation must respect the user's OS motion setting.
cards.cmds:
rg -n prefers-reduced-motion src
rg -c transition src
npx playwright --version

cards.title: Choose CSS classes or JavaScript hooks for modal motion

flutter test test/goldens/tile_golden_test.dart
